preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: All input lines are non-empty and properly formatted.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(line.isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines()[0].split())
preconditions.description: The first line contains exactly two integers n and m (1 ≤ n·m ≤ 10^6), where n is the number of books and m is the length of each book title.
The first line's integers n and m match the number of book titles and their length, respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each of the n book titles has exactly m uppercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(s.isupper() for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each book title consists only of uppercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: len({line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]}) == n
preconditions.description: All book titles are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(idx) <= n for idx in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a valid book index between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(idx1 != idx2 for idx1, idx2 in combinations(stdout.split(), 2))
postconditions.description: All output indices are unique (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i < n for i in range(n) if (asc_desc_compare(books[int(stdout.split()[i]) - 1], books[int(stdout.split()[i + 1]) - 1]) <= 0))
postconditions.description: For every pair of consecutive indices in the output, the corresponding book titles satisfy the asc-desc-ending order, where odd positions (1-based) are compared ascendingly and even positions descendingly.
